info.title: Student Information Management System API
info.description: Laravel Sanctum API. Management resources require Admin or Staff. Instructor and Student self-service endpoints enforce ownership. Resource update routes documented as PUT also accept PATCH.

post.summary: Login and create a Sanctum token

get.summary: Student academic record; Admin/Staff or linked Student only

post.summary: Submit grade for assigned offering (Instructor only)

put.summary: Update grade for assigned offering (Instructor only)

get.summary: List active Instructor accounts for assignment (Admin/Staff)

200.description: Active Instructor accounts available for Course Offering assignment.

get.summary: List enrollments for the authenticated Instructor's assigned offerings

instructor_id.description: Optional. When provided, must reference an existing user whose role is Instructor.
